---
title: "🗓️ Week 03 - SAR backscatter interpretation"
---

In this  week, we will get to know what parameters influence radar backscatter.

In addition, we will discuss experiences in reproducing the tutorial [SAR-based landcover classification with Sentinel-1 GRD products](https://step.esa.int/docs/tutorials/S1TBX%20Landcover%20classification%20with%20Sentinel-1%20GRD.pdf). 


## 👨‍🏫 Lecture Slides 

Click [here](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1hcKKyXK0w_zaFly415hYXnWBvU5kZ-v6/view?usp=sharing)to access the presentation.

## 📚 Practical exercise

- Complete the landcover classification tutorial with your own data and tool of choice. Bring your results to the next class.

- In case you stick to ESA SNAP, consider building a [graph of the workflow](https://drive.google.com/file/d/1NP9ebJmNpIySqkxyWupLurssHfHouGUB/view?usp=sharing).
